basis: Written after reviewing all 18 usable supplied conversations in the final post-update state (M07 at revision 2). It is fixed to this date and does not change with dashboard filters. Activity numbers on the brief page are computed live from the current imported state.
summary: The most urgent work today is with existing customers, not prospects. Willowfield Trust has reimbursements stuck in Processing, with a 1–2 hour update promised. Cedarwave's card programme is closing, and the customer says credit, not prepaid, is its main issue. Brookmint's login is still blocked. On the new-business side, two warm next steps need written follow-through (Harborpath partner kit, Asterloom proposal), and four call follow-ups have stated owners. Coaching themes are opening clarity, discovery over feature-listing, respecting a declined follow-up, and quoting recurring and one-time prices separately.

priorities.title: Willowfield Trust: reimbursements stuck in Processing; a 1–2 hour update was promised
priorities.why: An existing customer's released payments show as Processing for more than one user. Team member A promised an update within an hour or two and reproduced three further defects live.
priorities.action: Confirm the promised update was sent; raise three defect tickets with the shown steps; send one consolidated status message.

refs.quote: I expect an update or resolution in an hour or two, and I will inform you when they confirm.
The amount from the previous item appears in the next one.

priorities.title: Cedarwave: card programme closing; customer says credit is the main issue (retention risk)
priorities.why: Current cards will stop when the programme closes 'in the coming weeks'. The replacement is still prepaid, and the customer said they will have to consider another option for credit.
priorities.action: Answer the two open questions (eligibility of already-issued bank cards for the feed; accounting sync) and send a migration plan with dates.

refs.quote: moving from prepaid to credit is the main issue for us. At some stage we will have to consider another option for that.
I cannot confirm the existing-card eligibility on this call.

priorities.title: Brookmint Holdings: still locked out; fresh reset link says 'token expired'
priorities.why: The company with most of the customer's employees cannot log in. An update was promised today or Monday.
priorities.action: Diagnose the expired-token defect and update the customer by the stated deadline.

refs.quote: It says the token has expired. This is the fresh message we just received.
Brookmint Holdings has most of the employees.

priorities.title: Asterloom: send an itemised proposal; repair trust after the 26,000 → 39,000 price surprise
priorities.why: The buyer brought finance and wants a written proposal for CFO approval (4–5 employee pilot). Mid-meeting they discovered the cards are prepaid and that the quoted price had grown.
priorities.action: Send the proposal with recurring INR 26,000 + tax and one-time INR 13,000 itemised; no next meeting until they ask.

refs.quote: But you previously told me INR 26,000. Why has that become INR 39,000?
Send the details first. We need time with the CFO and will tell you if another call is needed.

priorities.title: Harborpath Advisory: partner ready to launch once terms and referral link are in writing
priorities.why: The partner asked to start onboarding and will publish the offer as soon as it has the documents, link and contact route.
priorities.action: Send the memorandum, written commission and pricing terms, unique referral link and referral requirements.

refs.quote: The main thing is to have all of that written down, with the link and contact route.

data_quality.issue: Stored labels that disagree with the text
data_quality.detail: C10 is labelled 'follow_up' but the prospect declined a follow-up call. C05 'follow_up' is a deck for a hypothetical switch. C02 is flagged as a conversation but reached only a receptionist. Routing never uses these labels as truth.
C06 is attributed to rep 'Meera' but the caller says 'Ravi here'. Per-person coaching for this call is held for human review.
M13 'SpendNest <> Cedarwave Distribution - Migration discussion' has no notetaker and the same organiser as M04, 30 minutes earlier. The association rests on the title only.

data_quality.issue: Similar names are not the same organisation
data_quality.detail: Harborlight Advisory (C01) vs Harborpath Advisory (M01); Willowbank Advisory (C07) vs Willowfield Trust (M07). No link is assumed.

not_established: No deal values, pipeline totals or purchase commitments are established by any conversation; spoken amounts are shown only as stated.

26 of 44 records have no usable supplied text. 20 background calls have no transcript, and 6 meetings have none (3 recorded with nobody speaking, 2 with the notetaker cancelled, 1 never scheduled). Nothing is inferred about them.
Meeting speaker labels ('Team member A') are local to each meeting and are not mapped to organiser emails, so meeting follow-ups are owned by a speaker label, not a named person.
M10 is internal billing training; it is excluded from sales priorities and coaching.
